sport.title: 2026 Davis Cup Quarterfinals Preview: Great Britain vs Germany A Key Matchup
paras: Defending Champions Italy and a host of challengers are all here, and now it’s time to take a look at the quarterfinal matchups that begin on Tuesday with Czechia vs Canada. Tomas Berdych’s Czech Republic has a deep squad as they bid to win the Davis Cup.

Top 20 singles players Jiri Lehecka and Jakub Mensik are here, along with Tomas Machac (#59), and the doubles pair of Patrik Rikl and Adam Pavlasek. Canada’s squad only has one top 100 player in singles or doubles, that’s the talented Felix Auger-Aliassime, who will carry a heavy burden.
sport.apply: Pick one shot from this match and copy it in your next practice. Ten minutes, slowly.

sport.title: November 24, 1996: The day Sampras won his third ATP Finals crown after an epic battle with Becker
paras: On this day, November 24, 1996, Pete Sampras and Boris Becker put on a serve-and-volley masterclass that is considered as one of the greatest matches in tennis history On this day, November 24, 1996, Pete Sampras edged Boris Becker (3-6, 7-6, 7-6, 6-7, 6-4) in the final of the ATP Tour World Championships.

The final showdown between the two champions is considered as one of the greatest matches in tennis history, with both players putting on a serve-and-volley masterclass on a fast indoor surface. It was also the last major final ever played by Becker.
sport.apply: Serve: practise the toss 20 times before you hit a single serve. Steady toss, steady serve.

sport.title: She was the first player to beat Coco Gauff in 2026 but is now ranked outside the top 100
paras: Coco Gauff’s 2026 season has officially come to an end after playing her last match of the year. Gauff helped the USA win their Billie Jean King Cup play-off tie against Hungary with both a singles win and a decisive doubles victory alongside Taylor Townsend .

Gauff has ended her season at a team event, exactly like she started it at the United Cup in Australia, where she suffered her first loss of the year. Which of these four WTA players will win the most Grand Slams next year? Sabalenka, Gauff and Swiatek all went without a major title in 2026…
sport.apply: Notice where the player stands to return. Try standing a step inside next time you play.
